scope: Eligibility-only first pass of exactly 29 existing review_order_group=1 candidate IDs. Group is work order, never a population cutoff.
controlling_rule: Primary research first published 2011-01-01 through 2026-09-18; calculates OER on rutile oxide (110); explicitly reports CHE overpotential in article or SI. No eta derived by this review.
limitations: All dispositions are provisional until independent reconciliation and discovery completion.
No OpenAlex request, forward expansion, queue edit, method-reporting outcome code, hypothesis tally or frozen inclusion list.
Indexed publisher passages differ from full PDF/HTML access. Failed tool opens do not prove permanent unavailability.
Metadata establishes identity and observed dates, not missing scientific evidence. Date conflicts are retained.
PDF text page markers support textual locators only; no visual-layout or numerical graph-reading claim.
